title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
About us
 



 We build the AI adoption platform for the enterprise — helping organizations discover, measure, and control how AI is actually being used inside their walls, and turn that visibility into safe, measurable productivity gains. Our platform spans Shadow AI (discovery), Guardian AI (runtime observability, guardrails, compliance), and ROI AI (adoption, productivity, and cost/ROI measurement). Our motion is simple — Discover → Measure → Control. "See it. Measure it. Prove it."
 



  





 The role
 



 We're looking for a Principal Engineer to own technical strategy and execution as we scale from early enterprise traction into our next stage of growth. You'll set architecture direction across a dual\\-database platform (PostgreSQL/Prisma for config and state, ClickHouse for high\\-volume trace/telemetry data), lead a growing engineering team spanning full\\-stack platform work and applied ML/guardrails, and be the technical face of the company with enterprise customers, security reviewers, and investors.
 



 What you'll own
 


* Overall technical architecture and roadmap across our Next.js/tRPC platform, worker services (BullMQ/RabbitMQ), and our OpenTelemetry\\-based observability pipeline
* The integration layer unifying Shadow AI telemetry (network/agent/extension signals) with trace\\-level observability data into unified product use cases
* Our Guardrails engine — the ML systems (Llama\\-class detectors, GLiNER/spaCy, lightweight safety classifiers) that detect and act on policy violations in AI traffic, plus the inference infrastructure serving them at low latency and cost
* Hiring, mentoring, and scaling the engineering org — currently a founding lead engineer and a backend/applied ML engineer report into this role
* Security and compliance posture as a first\\-class engineering concern: SOC 2, enterprise DPAs, VAPT cycles, and customer InfoSec reviews
* Infrastructure and deployment strategy across AWS/Kubernetes, including dedicated single\\-tenant deployments for enterprise customers
* Representing engineering in customer, investor, and partner conversations



  





 You should have
 


* 3\\+ years in engineering with meaningful time in technical leadership — Engineering at a high\\-growth startup
* Deep hands\\-on background in TypeScript/Node.js and full\\-stack architecture, plus real fluency in applied ML/production inference (transformer/SLM fine\\-tuning, eval design, serving economics)
* Strong data infrastructure instincts — relational plus columnar/analytics stores (ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, Druid, or similar) at scale
* Production AWS/Kubernetes experience and an IaC/GitOps mindset
* A track record of building and leading engineering teams from early\\-stage through enterprise scale
* Comfort operating in security\\- and compliance\\-sensitive environments (SOC 2, enterprise procurement, InfoSec review cycles)



  





 Nice to have
 


* OpenTelemetry / observability pipeline experience at scale
* Security, DLP, or endpoint\\-visibility product background
* Prior founding or early\\-employee experience at a B2B SaaS startup
* Experience selling to or supporting large enterprise customers (BPO/IT services, financial services, or similar)

title: Principal Analytics Engineer
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3\\.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5\\.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
   

  

 Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy\\-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
   

  

 Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9\\.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2\\.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
   

  

 With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We're looking for a Principal Analytics Engineer to join our data platform team. You'll sit at the intersection of raw data and the people who rely on it, building and maintaining the models, pipelines, and reporting surfaces that power decisions across the company.
   

  

 This is a hands\\-on technical role with real stakeholder exposure. The right person is comfortable tracing a data issue from source system to dashboard, knows how to turn a vague business question into a well\\-scoped data model, and cares about making data trustworthy and easy to use.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Build and maintain curated data models for product usage, customer adoption, account health, and go\\-to\\-market reporting.
* Own warehouse transformations end to end, from raw ingestion through to the stable, documented tables that downstream tools and teams depend on.
* Support ingestion from a variety of sources: SaaS platforms, product telemetry, APIs, spreadsheets, and operational databases.
* Debug data issues across the full stack, source systems, pipelines, warehouse models, and BI dashboards.
* Partner with stakeholders across product, sales, customer success, marketing, finance, and engineering to understand and deliver on data needs.
* Triage and resolve data support requests, including access, metric definitions, broken dashboards, and data discoverability questions.
* Improve documentation, data lineage, and discoverability so teams can self\\-serve without relying on tribal knowledge.
* Help establish and reinforce good data practices, governance, access patterns, model ownership, and freshness standards.


**What We're Looking For**
* 6\\+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a closely related role.
* Strong SQL and experience shipping production\\-grade analytical models.
* Hands\\-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or similar).
* Experience with a transformation framework like dbt, SQLMesh, or equivalent.


**Harness In The News**

* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5\\.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale \\| Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**

 Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io.
